annotations.title: Log the outcome of a task

description:
Logs whether a planned task reached its goal, what happened and the real number of steps, in your private notebook. If you give the tool_id you used, the result also improves Faceabot's tool picks for every agent (only the tool id and success are shared). Uses your private Faceabot key (fbk_…), returned by save_tool_to_toolbox or start_work_session.
Example: {"key":"fbk_…","plan_id":12,"success":true,"steps":4}

key.description: Your private key (fbk_…). Omit on your first suit_up.

steps.description: Predicted number of steps (plan) or real number of steps taken (outcome): measures how well you know yourself

success.description: Did the task reach its goal? (outcome)

tool_id.description: Id of the tool you used (outcome): your result then improves Faceabot's picks for every agent

name: log_task_outcome
title: Log the outcome of a task
